title: A Space website's Contact page opens with the contact form, then the story and photo, then the stats

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07: 'I want the contact form as the Hero presentation. Re work the content below so the stats are below the content and picture.'

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: the website Contact page opened with the About story, its stats squeezed into the text column, and the contact form sat halfway down the page. THE FIX: buildHouseContact puts the Contact form first as the page hero (its heading is the page's h1), the About story and photo follow, and the facts run as a full-width row under both. The closing band with the contact details still ends the page.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/sites/house-home.tsx','utf8');if(!/blocks: HouseBlockModel\[\] = \[inquiryOf\(bag\('contactForm'\)[^\n]*true\)\]/.test(s)||!/factsBelow: true/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-837: the website Contact page does not open with the form hero and stats below');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (the form is the second section); passes once this lands.
